 Chelsea FCW vs. AS Roma Femminile, UEFA Women’s Champions League: Confirmed lineups; how to watch
 Time to play
 by Fellipe Miranda Oct 28, 2026, 4:39 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 A general view inside the stadium during the Sky Bet League 2 match between AFC Wimbledon and Barrow at Plough Lane in Wimbledon, England, on March 22, 2025. (Photo by MI News/NurPhoto via Getty Images) NurPhoto via Getty Images Chelsea Women head into their third UEFA Women’s Champions League group stage match this season, as they take on Italian outfit AS Roma at Plough Lane.
 It’s an interesting matchup, with the Serie A side’s last outing in the competition being a 6-0 defeat at the hands of current champions, Barcelona. If the Blues are to challenge for this title this season, they best look past their earlier struggles in the championship and run up the score against the Giallorossi as well.
 Chelsea starting lineup (4-2-3-1): 
Hampton | Bronze, Buchanan, Buurman, Baltimore | Cuthbert (c), Potter | James, Kaptein, Thompson | Beever-Jones
 Substitutes from: Peng, Spencer, Carpenter, Björn, McCabe, Nüsken, Dragoni, Walsh, Hamano, Brown, Matsukubo, Malard 
 AS Roma starting eleven: 
Baldi | Bergamaschi, Antoine, Oladipo, Heatley, Oliviero, Cimò, Greggi (c), Doms, Dooren, Piemonte
 Substitutes from: Soggiu, Ottey, Thogersen, Vergani, Piekarska, Jahnukainen, Giugliano, Pandini, Rieke, Pilgrim, Corelli, Babajide 
 Date / Time: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, 17:45 GMT; 1:45 pm EDT
 Venue: Plough Lane, Wimbledon, UK
 Referee: Olatz Rivera Olmedo (ESP)
 On TV: none (UK); none (US); elsewhere 
 Streaming: Disney+ (UK); ESPN+, fuboTV, Paramount+ (US)
